name: WdInsertedTextMark
description: Specifies the formatting of text that is inserted while change tracking is enabled.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkNone
constants.description: Inserted text is not marked up.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkBold
constants.description: Inserted text is displayed in bold.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkItalic
constants.description: Inserted text is displayed in italic.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkDoubleUnderline
constants.description: Inserted text is marked up by using double-underline characters.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkColorOnly
constants.description: Inserted text is displayed in a specified color.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkStrikeThrough
constants.description: Inserted text is marked up by using strikethrough characters.

constants.name: wdInsertedTextMarkDoubleStrikeThrough
constants.description: Inserted text is marked up by using double-strikethrough characters.
